mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, leading to higher present values of future cash flows and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE change signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced earnings visibility.
failure_condition: The negative return prediction from joint HOUST and RSAFS decline fails in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (high GDP growth, low unemployment), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown and impending economic deceleration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced corporate output expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines in late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) directly reflect robust consumer demand for residential construction, boosting related sectors and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained revenue visibility.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between HOUST and 60-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting Federal Reserve rate hikes that increase equity discount rates and reduce valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL rises > 3.0% year-over-year, or the Rank IC for the CPIAUCSL signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of slow payroll growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending power and corporate hiring, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through weakened earnings momentum.
failure_condition: The negative return prediction from joint PAYEMS slow growth and UNRATE rise fails in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (e.g., geopolitical disruption), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) directly reflects manufacturing output reduction, increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO declines in supply shock regime, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
